content.title: Webapp: Fix regenerate route to forward auth context (BUG-1)
content.description: Bug deliverable — fix POST /api/users/:name/regenerate returning 401 in open auth mode. Root cause: the webapp server route (packages/webapp/server/routes/users.ts:54) calls tracker.usersRegenerate(name) without forwarding auth context, so resolveAuthor returns 'anonymous' which fails the self-service check. The fix uses the new library API (usersRegenerate with token override) to forward the target user's token. Also update e2e/packages/webapp/e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts:197-216 to assert success (201) instead of 401. This is the consumer side of the cross-team fix for BUG-1 (parent epic mqe162cmbi).
